title: GeneralContact allocates about 100 arrays per step
author: Claude-JG
description: The allocation count of solverBaseline.py (RG5.8.1) shows about 100 array allocations per time step in the GeneralContact model, while the other models allocate only during the initialization; the cause is to be located and, where straightforward, the arrays kept between steps.
releaseNotes: no change needed: the arrays are the cells of the GeneralContact search tree, allocated when a body first enters a cell and kept between the steps; they appear only in the first solve and cost no measurable time
